Product Description

 This set comes with 3 sheets of window clings with distinct patterns. Abundant quantity and diverse styles help you match many different home decoration themes easily.
 These decals are printed with mixed Christmas tree and snowflake elements. The color palette centers on green gold and white, with a simple modern style to add lively festive atmosphere for your Xmas window decor.

Specifications

 Size: 20 x 30 cm

Package Includes

 3 x Christmas window clings

 Wipe the target surface clean and dry before application for better static sticking effect.

【Two Way Visible Print Craft】: Decorative graphics are printed on both faces of the cling. The lovely patterns stay clearly visible from indoors and outdoors, grabbing more attention from onlookers outside.
【Reusable Static PVC Application】: Built with high grade electrostatic PVC film. Lightly mist water on the glass before placement for a tighter hold. They peel away smoothly without sticky residue and support repeated use.
【Multi Surface Holiday Decor Option】: Suitable for nearly all smooth flat surfaces including glass, mirrors, tiles, furniture and shop showcases. Great decoration for Christmas, winter holidays, family reunions and birthday parties.

Christmas Gnome Advent Calendar: Festive Countdown & Home Decor
Charming Gnome Theme for Holiday Joy
This Gnome Advent Calendar spotlights beloved gnome and elf characters—classic, cute figures that bring extra festive fun to the Christmas season. Their whimsical design adds warmth and surprise to your home, setting a cheerful tone from the moment you display it.
Classic Christmas Countdown Function
Just like traditional Christmas countdown calendars, it starts on December 1. Each day, you can open a small door or package to uncover a tiny gift inside, continuing the daily surprise right up to Christmas Eve. This ritual builds excitement as the holiday approaches, making the wait for Christmas feel special and enjoyable.
Beautiful Decor for Festive Spaces
The calendar features a lovely exterior design, decorated with gnome images and iconic Christmas elements such as Christmas trees, snowflakes, and gift boxes. It’s not just a countdown tool—its eye-catching look makes it perfect for festive desktop decorations. Place it on your living room table, bedroom dresser, or entryway shelf to instantly boost your home’s holiday vibe.
Fun for Every Age, Great for Family Time
This Gnome Advent Calendar suits both children and adults. Kids will love the daily thrill of opening a new gift, while adults can enjoy the nostalgic, cozy feel it brings to the season. It also works as a wonderful family Christmas activity—gather together each day to open the calendar, share laughs, and add interactive fun to your holiday celebrations.
Customizable to Make It Personal
The small gifts behind each door can be chosen based on personal preferences or a specific theme. This lets you tailor the calendar to the recipient, making every one unique. Whether you pick gifts that match their hobbies or fit a cozy Christmas theme, it shows the care and thought you put into the present, turning it into a meaningful keepsake.
Festive Christmas-themed design: Features red Christmas style and Santa pants pattern, serving as lovely Christmas decorations that can be placed at home, on the table, or under the Christmas tree to boost holiday atmosphere.
Versatile for holding various items: Capable of containing not only red wine, chocolates, sweets, and other foods but also different kinds of gifts, meeting diverse storage needs.
Perfect for gifting to multiple groups: Works as an excellent Christmas gift bag for presenting to friends, lovers, kids, neighbors, and family members, which is sure to be loved.
Ideal for holiday parties: Suitable for both hosting and attending holiday parties, functioning well as a Christmas gift wrapper and a great wine bottle bag.
Conveys love and enhances Christmas joy: The red Santa pants gift bag is filled with love, helping to create a wonderful and memorable Christmas experience for your kids and family.
Guarantee - 6 months

5056797099180.sourceDescription:
Create a luxurious festive display with this light up Christmas tree from MySmartBuy. The modern tiered tree outline is densely wrapped in 720 warm white micro LEDs, creating a rich, sparkling glow that makes a beautiful focal point in a window, on a sideboard or on a shelf. The stylish champagne gold metal frame stands on slim legs above a flat base, so it sits neatly and securely on windowsills, tabletops and mantelpieces. At 45cm tall, it is a versatile size that makes an impact without taking over the room, and looks just as elegant unlit during the day. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening and greets passers-by with a warm festive glow from your window. Pair it with the matching champagne gold snowflake for a coordinated look, or group it with candles and greenery for an elegant Christmas display. At a glance: 45cm tall | 720 warm white micro LEDs | champagne gold metal frame on a flat base | 5m lead cable | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | indoor use.
SPARKLING TIERED TREE – A modern Christmas tree outline densely wrapped in 720 warm white micro LEDs for a rich festive glow.
CHAMPAGNE GOLD FRAME – A stylish metal frame on slim legs and a flat base, looking elegant lit or unlit.
45CM TALL – A versatile size for windowsills, tabletops, sideboards, shelves and mantelpieces.
5M LEAD CABLE – Plenty of reach from your socket, so you can place it exactly where it looks best.

5096825933680.sourceDescription:
Christmas Tree Decorations
Adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. Dimensions: 90 cm. Quantity: 1 piece.
Festive white hanging ornament adds a decorative focal point to your Christmas tree display.
Generous 90 cm diameter size makes a bold statement and enhances visibility among other decorations.
Crafted from soft pluche fabric for a luxurious texture and gentle handling during placement.
Versatile single-item design allows flexible positioning to refresh your holiday arrangement easily.
For Indoor Use

0609137988580.sourceDescription:
Transform your holiday home display into a breathtaking winter scene with the 48-Inch (122cm) LED Snowflake with Rotating Prismatic Star Light. Specifically engineered as a grand-scale seasonal focal point, this striking light-up display features a majestic, multi-tiered snowflake structure centered by a magical, spinning star centerpiece that completely elevates your property’s festive curb presence.
Equipped with 180 high-brilliance, energy-efficient LED lights, the snowflake emits a crisp, icy glow while remaining completely cold to the touch. To add a dynamic, magical shimmer to your display, 15 integrated micro-bulbs subtly twinkle while the central prismatic star rotates smoothly. Built around a commercial-grade, rust-resistant powder-coated metal frame, it includes heavy-duty metal ground stakes for solid lawn stabilization. Outfitted with an extra-long 10-meter lead wire and a certified UK outdoor plug adapter, it offers absolute placement freedom across front lawns, patios, entryways, or indoor living rooms.
